concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-dana]] — 2026-09-15 DANA ID/IDR wallet overview for shopper redirect, five-minute default redirect-page lifetime, 300-IDR display floor, capability matrix and channel child routes; redirect/result display is not merchant-side outcome proof.
warnings: Recurring and refund marks are overview capabilities, not token/consent/refund procedure or a completed payment.
The default five-minute redirect-page timeout and 300-IDR method-display floor should not be generalized into payment-finality or eligibility guarantees.
